full_text_zh:
[P1] 暖房子国际大奖绘本
神奇飞书
【美】威廉·乔伊斯/著
【美】威廉·乔伊斯、乔·布鲁姆/绘
王从/译
云南出版集团公司
晨光出版社
奥斯卡
金像奖
最佳动画短片
绘本版

[P3] 可是，并非所有的故事都是一帆风顺。
有一天，天空突然乌云密布，
飓风呼啸而来……

[P5] 它摧毁了所有的一切，包括莫里斯的书。

[P6] 莫里斯茫然不知所措，他无处可去，
只好漫无目的地
四处游荡……

[P7] 突然，神奇的事情发生了。
莫里斯早已习惯了埋头行走，这一天，却抬起头来向上看，
他看见一位可爱的女孩飘过天空，
手里握着一束神奇飞书。

[P9] 莫里斯想试试他的书是不是也能飞，结果不能。
他的书只能“砰”的一声摔落在地。
飞翔的女孩知道莫里斯渴望着一个好故事，就把自己最珍爱的一本书
送给了他。
这本书非常友善，邀请莫里斯跟他走。

[P11] 这本书带着莫里斯来到一幢奇特的房子前。
那里住着很多的书。

[P12] 莫里斯缓步走了进去，发现
这是一个他从未见过的、最神秘最吸引人的房间。
不计其数的书振翼飞行，充盈其中。千万个故事在窃窃私语，
好像每本书都在
轻声邀请莫里斯探寻其间。

[P13] 莫里斯的新朋友飞过来，停留在他的手臂上，
自动翻着书页，希望被莫里斯读到。
房间里沙沙声一片，
每本书仿佛都有着自己的生命。
于是，莫里斯开始了与书相伴的生活。

[P14] 莫里斯想按某种顺序整理好这些书，不过书籍们却总是把自己弄得很乱。
悲剧书想要振作起来，就会去和喜剧书聊一聊。
大百科全书呢，厌倦了枯燥的知识，就跑去找漫画和小说来消遣。
总的来说，这些书乱得还不算太离谱。
莫里斯总是细心地修补好撕坏的封面，或是把卷角的书页展平。
他在照顾这些书时，觉得很满足。

[P15] 有时候，
莫里斯会沉浸在某本书中，
一看就是好几天。

[P16] 莫里斯喜欢和别人分享这些书。
有时，他分享的书，大家都爱读；
有时，他也发现一些孤单的小书，很少被人读到。
莫里斯说：“每个人的故事都很重要。”
所有的书都认为他说得有道理。

[P17] 夜晚，当所有需要讲的故事都讲完，所有的书
都放回到书架上的固定位置后，
厚厚的大词典里会飞出最后一个词语：

一呼噜一呼噜一

这时，莫里斯会再次翻开他自己的那本书，
写下他的欢乐与悲伤，理想和希望。

[P18] 就这样，一天又一天，

一个月又一个月，

[P19] 一年
又一年……

[P20] 莫里斯变得弯腰驼背，满脸皱纹。
不过，书却一点儿都没变。
书里的故事，也依然如初。
现在，轮到这些老朋友来照顾莫里斯了，
就像莫里斯曾经照顾他们一样。
每天晚上，书籍们都把自己的故事
读给莫里斯听。

[P21] 有一天，莫里斯写完了最后一页。
他抬起头，带着疲惫与甜蜜，
发出一声叹息：
“我想我该走了。”

[P22] 书籍们很伤心，
但他们都知道，这一刻终会来临。
莫里斯戴上帽子，拿起拐杖。
他走到门口，转过身来挥手告别。
“我会把你们都放在心上。”
他手抚胸口，对大家说。

[P23] 书籍们纷纷张开书页，带着莫里斯飞了起来。
莫里斯重新回到了来时的路，那是很久以前
他们初次相见的地方。

[P24] 书籍们沉默了一段时间，
他们发现，莫里斯留下了一样东西。
“是他的书！”莫里斯的老朋友说。
在莫里斯的书里，记录着他的
欢乐与悲伤，理想和希望。

[P25] 这时，书籍们听到了一个细微的、他们期盼已久的声音——
门外走来一个小姑娘，她惊奇地环顾四周。
就在这时，神奇的事情发生了。
莫里斯的书飞向小姑娘，自动翻开了书页。
小女孩读了起来。
我们的故事结束了，一个新的故事开始了……

[P26] 这又是一本——翻开的书。
full_text_en:
[P1] Warm House International Award Picture Book
The Fantastic Flying Book
[US] William Joyce / Author
[US] William Joyce, Joe Bluhm / Illustrator
Wang Cong / Translator
Yunnan Publishing Group Company
Chenguang Publishing House
Academy Award
Oscar
Best Animated Short Film
Picture Book Edition

[P3] But not all stories go smoothly.
One day, the sky suddenly became filled with dark clouds,
and a fierce hurricane roared in...

[P5] It destroyed everything, including Morris's books.

[P6] Maurice was lost and confused. He had nowhere to go,
so he wandered aimlessly,
roaming everywhere...

[P7] Suddenly, something magical happened.
Maurice, who had long been used to walking with his head down, on this day, lifted his head and looked up,
he saw a lovely girl floating across the sky,
holding a bundle of magical flying books in her hands.

[P9] Maurice wanted to try if his book could fly too, but it couldn't.
His book just landed with a 'thud' on the ground.
The flying girl knew Maurice longed for a good story, so she gave him her most beloved book.
This book was very kind and invited Maurice to come with her.

[P11] This book brought Morris to a strange house.
Many books lived there.

[P12] Maurice stepped slowly inside and discovered
a room unlike any he had ever seen—the most mysterious and captivating room.
Countless books fluttered through the air, filling the space. Millions of stories whispered softly,
as if each book were
quietly inviting Maurice to explore within.

[P13] Maurice's new friend flies over and lands on his arm,
flipping its pages automatically, hoping to be read by Maurice.
The room is filled with a rustling sound,
each book seeming to have its own life.
Thus, Maurice begins a life accompanied by books.

[P14] Maurice wanted to organize these books in some order, but the books always managed to get themselves into a mess.
The tragedy books, wanting to cheer up, would go chat with the comedy books.
The encyclopedia, tired of dry facts, would run off to hang out with comics and novels.
All in all, the books weren't too chaotic.
Maurice always carefully repaired torn covers or flattened curled pages.
He felt very content while taking care of them.

[P15] Sometimes,
Maurice would lose himself in a book,
reading for days on end.

[P16] Maurice liked to share these books with others.
Sometimes, the books he shared were loved by everyone;
sometimes, he also found some lonely little books, rarely read by anyone.
Maurice said, "Everyone's story is important."
All the books thought he was right.

[P17] At night, when all the stories that need to be told are finished, and all the books
are returned to their fixed places on the shelves,
the thick dictionary will release its last word:

—Huff—Huff—

At this moment, Morris will open his own book again,
and write down his joys and sorrows, dreams and hopes.

[P18] And so, day after day,

month after month,

[P19] One year
Another year...

[P20] Maurice had become hunched and wrinkled.
But the books had not changed at all.
The stories within them remained as they were.
Now, it was the turn of these old friends to care for Maurice,
just as Maurice had once cared for them.
Every evening, the books read their stories
aloud to Maurice.

[P21] One day, Morris finished the last page.
He looked up, tired yet sweetly content,
and sighed:
"I think it's time for me to go."

[P22] The books were sad,
but they all knew this moment would come.
Maurice put on his hat and picked up his cane.
He walked to the door, turned around, and waved goodbye.
"I will keep you all in my heart."
He placed a hand on his chest and said to everyone.

[P23] The books opened their pages and carried Morris up into the sky.
Morris returned to the path he had come from, the place where they had first met long ago.

[P24] The books fell silent for a while.
They discovered that Morris had left something behind.
"It's his book!" said Morris's old friend.
In Morris's book, his joys and sorrows, dreams and hopes were recorded.

[P25] At this moment, the books heard a faint, long-awaited sound—
A little girl came through the door, looking around in wonder.
Just then, something magical happened.
Morris's book flew toward the little girl and turned its pages automatically.
The little girl began to read.
Our story has ended, and a new story has begun……

[P26] This is another book—opened.
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《神奇飞书》的封面，展示了主角坐在绿色扶手椅上阅读，周围堆满书籍，背景为窗户，画面右下角有奥斯卡金像奖标识。
[P2] 画面中，一位戴着帽子的男子坐在绿色扶手椅上阅读书籍，周围堆满了书本，背景是一扇窗户，场景位于一个阳台或露台上，阳光洒入，营造出宁静的阅读氛围。
[P3] 画面描绘了城市上空乌云密布、飓风来袭的场景，书籍和家具被吹得四处飘散，预示着故事即将发生重大转折。
[P4] 画面描绘了飓风肆虐的场景，主角被强风吹得在空中翻滚，周围房屋、家具和书籍四处飞散，城市陷入混乱。
[P5] 飓风摧毁了所有的一切，包括主角莫里斯的书，画面中一本打开的书散落着字母，象征知识与故事的破碎。
[P6] 飓风过后，莫里斯在废墟中茫然无措，无处可去，只能漫无目的地四处游荡。
[P7] 莫里斯在茫然游荡时，突然抬头看见一位女孩手持神奇飞书从天空飘过，预示着故事的转折点到来。
[P8] 画面中，一位身穿印有字母长裙的女孩在蓝天白云间飞翔，她手持一本打开的书，另一只手牵着一束由彩色书籍组成的气球，象征着知识与故事的自由翱翔。
[P9] 莫里斯尝试让自己的书飞翔失败后，飞翔的女孩将自己最珍爱的一本书送给他，这本书主动邀请他一同前行。
[P10] 莫里斯站在废墟中的黄色栅栏旁，抬头望着一本正在空中飞翔的书，书页上画着一个戴着帽子的蛋形角色，象征着新故事的开始。
[P11] 莫里斯跟随一本会飞的书来到一座由书籍构成的奇特房子前，房子周围和门内飘散着许多书，暗示这里是一个充满故事与知识的神秘场所。
[P12] 莫里斯走进一间由书籍构成的神秘房间，无数书本在空中飞舞，仿佛在低语，邀请他探索其中的奥秘。
[P13] 莫里斯的新朋友——一本会飞的书，停在他手臂上翻动书页，房间中无数书本仿佛有了生命，在空中飞舞，莫里斯由此开始了与书相伴的生活。
[P14] 莫里斯在一间由书籍构成的房间里，试图整理混乱的书本，但书本们各有想法，不愿被固定。他细心修补破损的书页，从中获得满足感。
[P15] 莫里斯在巨大的书页间攀爬和跳跃，沉浸在阅读中，画面表现了他与书籍的亲密互动和对阅读的专注。
[P16] 莫里斯在窗边向一群孩子分享书籍，他强调每个人的故事都很重要，所有书都认同他的观点。
[P17] 夜晚，所有书归位后，大词典中飞出最后一个词语，莫里斯随后翻开自己的书，记录下自己的情感与理想。
[P18] 画面描绘了莫里斯在树下阅读的宁静场景，背景是书籍构成的房子，时间在阅读中悄然流逝。
[P19] 画面通过四季更替的场景，展现莫里斯在树下阅读的时光流逝，从秋日暖阳到冬夜月光，暗示他与书籍相伴的岁月不断延续。
[P20] 莫里斯年老体衰，但书籍依然如初，它们反过来照顾他，每晚为他朗读故事，体现了彼此间深厚的情感与陪伴。
[P21] 莫里斯写完最后一本书页，抬头叹息，表示自己该离开了，画面中他坐在书架环绕的房间里，阳光透过窗户洒入，营造出宁静而感伤的氛围。
[P22] 年迈的莫里斯准备离开，他向陪伴多年的书籍们告别，并承诺将它们永远记在心里。
[P23] 莫里斯被书籍带着飞向天空，重返他与书籍初次相遇的地方，画面充满诗意与告别之情。
[P24] 莫里斯离开后，书籍们发现他留下了一本记录着他一生情感与理想的书，老朋友对此表示感慨。
[P25] 莫里斯的书飞向一个来到门前的小女孩，自动翻开书页，小女孩开始阅读，象征着故事的传承与延续。
[P26] 一个小女孩坐在书屋门前的台阶上阅读，周围有许多拟人化的书本围绕着她，画面传达出阅读的延续与传承。
